selfHelp: You are not alone. This feeling can pass.
Try 4-7-8 breathing: inhale for 4 seconds, hold for 7 seconds, exhale for 8 seconds.
Talk to someone you trust today. You do not have to carry this alone.
Step outside for fresh air or splash cold water on your face to help reset your nervous system.
howToSupport: Ask directly: 'Are you thinking about suicide?' Asking does not plant the idea; it opens a door for them to talk.
Stay with them if they are in immediate danger and call a hotline together.
Do not promise to keep it a secret if their life is at risk.
